research_rationale: Continuous assignment uses the exact prior status decision and scope-limited cross-family review, then newly examines every original provision, first cessation, FAR trigger, USPS policies and savings. EO13975 is a continuing presidential Buy American policy and nonbinding encouragement; it neither changes the USPS SPP itself nor commands adoption of specified thresholds. Nine original units retain all sections1-5. EO14005 section14(a) unconditionally revokes the whole order with immediate hereby wording on January25,2021; section14(b) partial supersession applies to other orders. The original has no sunset, event-conditioned termination, independent report, records, transfer, enforcement or recurring amendment command. Actual USPS consideration is not established, and unchanged SPP thresholds are not proof of no consideration. The producer legal interpretation is that possible prior consideration would not itself withdraw the presidential policy/encouragement; no text makes consideration a termination event. FAR issuance starts the recommended consideration interval, not an ending. FAR Case2019-016,86FR6180, published January19,2021 with February22 solicitation applicability, has an effective-date correction to January19 in86FR8308; no automatic USPS amendment or target revival follows. SPP June2020 and September2021 p200 retain six-percent/fifty-percent rules. A bounded negative search is disclosed, not an exhaustive absence proof; all sources and limitations are in b01/RESEARCH.md. No prior status review is treated as lifecycle approval.
savings_reason: Section5(a) preserves external statutory agency/USPS/OMB authority and5(c) creates no enforceable right. These are not savings of EO13975 after repeal. EO14005 sections14-16 contain no target-specific reservation or accrued right. USPS pre-existing SPP rules survive under independent authority but were not created by this EO; this claim does not purport to extinguish them or the independent Buy American statutory/FAR regime. No separate target-derived residual was found in the cited bounded sources.
